comparison.objective: Open a drink can using its stay-on tab.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine pinch in a recessed area, tab lifting about a rivet, and seal-breaking force control.
comparison.success_condition: Panel depressed at least 45 degrees after the tab was raised at least 10 degrees; later versions require hands clear for one second. Spill and can damage are not specified.
comparison.reason: Fine tab manipulation and seal rupture do not exercise the candidate’s bimanual screen handling, granular-flow control, or part retention.
